hold_text: R12 is RIGHT and I am not defeating it. This branch is STACKED on #12094, so its diff against main carries that PR's own `.github/pr-landing/mi280-u49-guard-base-census.json` -- and `.github/pr-landing/*.json` is LANDING_MACHINERY. The change and its own approval would be the same act. ⚠️ Note WHY it trips, because it is not what the phrase usually means: this PR's OWN content is one scripts/ops guard and touches no landing rule at all; it inherits the machinery path from the branch it is stacked on. If #12094 merges first the diff narrows and the condition disappears on its own -- so the cheapest resolution is to merge #12094, after which this can be re-declared `self`. Routed to the manager rather than worked around. The underlying change is verified three ways: a genuine violation still exits 1, an older base no longer false-blames, and the live tree is clean.
why: One guard, scripts/ops/check_backlog_criteria.py, resolved through scripts/ci/_git_base.py so its two diff-scoped checks compare against the branch's fork point rather than the base tip. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no workflow, and no backlog row -- deliberately, to keep the register conflict surface down while this lane has PRs in flight.
